content: $\textit {MEV}_\ell (w)$ is the proportion of variance in $w$'s contextualized representations for a given layer that can be explained by their first principal component. It gives us an upper bound on how well a static embedding could replace a word's contextualized representations. The closer $\textit {MEV}_\ell (w)$ is to 0, the poorer a replacement a static embedding would be; if $\textit {MEV}_\ell (w) = 1$, then a static embedding would be a perfect replacement for the contextualized representations.
